description: This file contains unit tests for the MetricsStatsCounter class, specifically testing cache metrics tracking within the org.eclipse.ditto.services.utils.cache package. It uses the JUnit framework and the Caffeine cache library to verify metrics such as hits, misses, evictions, and invalidations in a caching scenario.

classes.name: MetricsStatsCounterTest
classes.description: Unit test class for validating cache metrics collection and reporting in the org.eclipse.ditto.services.utils.cache package using Caffeine cache and MetricsMetrics.

methods.name: resetMetrics
methods.description: Resets all metric counters and gauges to zero before each test.

methods.name: basicUsage
methods.description: Tests basic cache hit/miss metrics and size estimations after performing cache get operations.

methods.name: evictions
methods.description: Verifies that cache evictions are being tracked when the cache exceeds its maximum size.

methods.name: waitUntilAsserted
methods.description: Helper method that waits until the provided assertions pass, with a timeout.

methods.name: invalidate
methods.description: Tests invalidation of cache entries and verifies the invalidation metrics.

methods.name: createCaffeineCache
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of CaffeineCache with specified maximum size and loader.

methods.name: requestNTimes
methods.description: Requests a cache entry multiple times to generate hit/miss metrics.
